invariants.statement: Operational SEO thresholds are sourced from the site config rather than duplicated in phase scripts.
Server credentials must not be committed or echoed by repository security guards.
Production promotion is skipped for changes proven to be non-runtime and is fail-closed for runtime or unknown paths.
The existing SectorCalc SEO registry remains the canonical page-state authority and rejects duplicate canonical or primary query ownership.
Pages with incomplete, broken, placeholder or regeneration-pending state are not eligible for indexability.
